title: Prehistoric and Medieval Skis from Glaciers and Ice Patches in Norway
version: Journal of Glacial Archaeology 3(1), issue 2016 / copyright 2018, printed p. 45
lineage: Original paper PDF was inspected. The retained file is an attributed paraphrase and the early object’s ski identification remains qualified.

passages.note: Printed p. 45: a Siberian object claimed as a ski is dated approximately 6000 BCE; Nordic finds are later.
